issues.title: Track semantic-pack default promotion and coverage audit

scope.process_note: This artifact records post-closeout independent review evidence. It does not relabel missing pre-closeout artifacts as pre-closeout review.

rounds.prompt_boundary: Five independent subagents reviewed the already closed #676-#679 work against issue requirements, durable evidence, documentation, CI evidence, and the no-performance-degradation constraint. They were asked for findings only and did not edit files.

reviewers.name: Hooke
blocking_findings: Issues #677, #678, and #679 claimed independent review in closeout prose without a durable artifact naming reviewer, reviewed state, prompt boundary, findings, accepted changes, and rejected feedback.
non_blocking_findings: #676 runtime evidence was a same-binary control, not a before/after product-runtime proof.
#676 real-history artifact contained one commit and one singleton group; repeated real findings across commits were not artifact-proven.

reviewers.name: Sartre
blocking_findings: #676 release evidence provenance was not clean/reproducible: the original artifact recorded current_head 4283439e while the implementation landed at df2aab26, and the runtime artifact recorded a dirty working tree.
non_blocking_findings: #677 named future semantic prerequisites but did not track them in an open GitHub issue.
scripts/check-duplication.sh ratchet comments ended at 29 -> 29 and missed the #679 29 -> 26 tightening.

reviewers.name: Nash
blocking_findings: #676 did not carry durable independent review evidence if treated as part of the divergent-edit tracker process.
#676 history artifact had occurrence_count 1, so repeated real findings across commits were not raw-artifact-proven.
non_blocking_findings: #676 and #677 performance evidence should be described as no-hot-path or same-binary controls, not full before/after proof.
GitHub CI success does not include every issue-specific local command, so closeout should keep local and GitHub evidence distinct.
#678 source_outputs point at target files that were not checked in; the durable summary is present, but raw-output traceability is limited.

rounds.prompt_boundary: Five independent subagents reviewed commit ab9d3237 plus the closed #676-#679 work and the post-closeout fixes from round 1. They were asked to verify that round-1 findings were addressed or honestly recorded, that no performance-degradation claim was overstated, and that docs and durable artifacts were sufficient. They were asked not to edit files.

reviewed_state.working_tree: clean local main, ahead of origin/main before final artifact update and push

reviewers.name: Parfit
reviewers.checks_summary: Validated JSON artifacts, docs, formatting, file-length, duplication, divergent-history self-test, focused #677 hard-negative test, and crates verify.

reviewers.name: Einstein
non_blocking_findings: No GitHub Actions run was attached to local commit ab9d3237 yet; the commit only changed docs, review artifacts, and comments, and local checks covered that surface before push.
reviewers.checks_summary: Validated JSON artifacts, Python compile/self-test, docs, duplication, semantic-pack audit commands, GitHub issue links, and recorded implementation CI runs.

reviewers.name: Nietzsche
non_blocking_findings: The committed review artifact still said round 2 was pending; this final artifact update replaces that pending note with durable round-2 evidence.
reviewers.checks_summary: Validated JSON artifacts, Python compile/self-test, reproduced #676 clean recheck to scratch space, docs, duplication, semantic-pack commands, formatting, file-length, focused tests, and diff whitespace.

reviewers.name: Bernoulli
non_blocking_findings: Nash's round-1 note that GitHub CI does not include every issue-specific local command was present in round-1 findings but not explicitly accepted, rejected, or recorded as a limitation in accepted_feedback.
reviewers.checks_summary: Validated JSON artifacts, formatting, docs, duplication, file-length, diff whitespace, focused #677/#678/#679 tests, divergent-history self-test, GitHub issue links, and recorded implementation CI runs.

reviewers.name: Godel
reviewers.checks_summary: Validated JSON artifacts, divergent-history self-test, fresh #676 replay, focused #677/#678 tests, duplication, docs, semantic-pack commands, formatting, file-length, crates verify, diff whitespace, and git status.

accepted_feedback.finding: Durable independent review details were missing from closed issue evidence.
accepted_feedback.resolution: Added this committed closeout review artifact with reviewer identity, reviewed state, prompt boundary, findings, accepted changes, and explicit process-gap language for post-closeout review.

accepted_feedback.finding: #676 original real-history artifact provenance was tied to an old HEAD and the runtime artifact recorded a dirty tree.
accepted_feedback.resolution: Added bench/divergent_history/issue-676-clean-recheck-4283439e-2026-07-06.v1.json, generated from clean head de33d34e with the same target range 4283439e~1..4283439e and the release nose binary sha256 78b5eedeaaced187f2566e860561c36b77fdf3d3164b10daeb602fda0a2c109f.

accepted_feedback.finding: #676 repeated real findings across commits were not artifact-proven.
accepted_feedback.resolution: Recorded the limitation. A clean scratch probe over df2aab26~25..df2aab26 for crates/nose-cli/tests/cli analyzed 25 commits and found 32 groups, all singleton occurrence_count values; the self-test remains the durable grouped-repeat proof.

accepted_feedback.finding: #676 and #677 performance evidence should not be overstated as full before/after proof.
accepted_feedback.resolution: This artifact classifies #676 as a same-binary/base=HEAD control and #677 as no-product-code-change local runtime triage rather than behavior-changing before/after product evidence.

accepted_feedback.finding: #677 future exact prerequisites lacked open issue tracking.
accepted_feedback.resolution: Opened https://github.com/corca-ai/nose/issues/680 and linked it from docs/semantic-kernel-roadmap.md and docs/semantic-kernel-snapshot.md.
Added the #679 admission-resolver dogfooding ratchet note to scripts/check-duplication.sh.

Recorded this as a traceability limitation. The durable audit artifact keeps the summarized status, counts, and source command shapes; the target paths are treated as generation inputs, not retained closeout evidence.

accepted_feedback.finding: GitHub CI success does not include every issue-specific local command, so closeout should keep local and GitHub evidence distinct.
accepted_feedback.resolution: Recorded the distinction here: GitHub CI run IDs validate the repository CI gates for the four implementation commits, while issue-specific commands such as divergent-history self-test, Python compile, semantic-pack audit commands, focused query-regression checks, and focused hard-negative tests are local closeout evidence unless separately enforced by CI.

accepted_feedback.finding: The committed artifact still marked round 2 as pending.
accepted_feedback.resolution: Replaced the pending_follow_up_review section with durable round-2 reviewer records and final review status.

notes: Round 2 raised one process-documentation minor about CI/local evidence taxonomy and one artifact-state note about the old pending marker; both are accepted in this artifact update.

#676 still has no real-history repeated-group artifact beyond the synthetic self-test; the clean wider scratch probe found only singleton groups, so this remains recorded as a limitation rather than a blocker.
#678 raw target source outputs remain scratch inputs; the committed audit artifact is the durable summary evidence.
